### Notes

The discount percentage and the length of the discount period are not published anywhere on the page. The $5 million figure is a ceiling on venture funding, not a floor. The application requires being signed in to a Clerk account that already has an application: "There are no applications associated with your account. Please sign in to a Clerk account with applications or create an application before applying." The partner dropdown is explicitly marked "Optional". The benefit is quoted only as "Apply to get Clerk Pro features at a discount for your early-stage startup" - no discount percentage is published.
